Eur. 6.2 (Promethazine Hydrochloride). A white or faintly yellowish, crystalline powder. Very soluble in water; freely solu- ble in alcohol and in dichloromethane. A 10% solution in water has a pH of 4.0 to 5.0. Protect from light. USP 31 (Promethazine Hydrochloride). A white to faint yellow, practically odourless, crystalline powder. Slowly oxidises and acquires a blue colour on prolonged exposure to air.
